# Weekly Newsletter

One issue has three to five items. Each item is one piece of research a teacher can act on.

1. **Find.** Look for research from the last few months that a classroom teacher could use. Prefer studies and reviews over opinion pieces. Keep the link and a one-line note on why it matters for each candidate. Skip topics the last two issues covered.
2. **Draft.** Write the issue in Traditional Chinese at `issues/{yyyy-mm-dd}.md`. Match the voice of the previous issues. `references/issue-format.md` has the layout.
3. **Check sources.** Reread the draft against each source. Every number, finding and quotation must be in the source as stated. Fix or cut what is not, and list what you cut at the end of your reply.
4. **Hand over.** Give the owner the draft path, the items with their sources, and anything you were unsure about. Revise when they ask. They decide when it is done.

If you cannot find three sourced items, say so and hand over what you have rather than padding the issue.
